definitions: To return to a place, especially a home or building, after having left it for a period.
To reoccupy a dwelling or space.
examples: They plan to move back into their renovated house next month.
After college, she decided to move back into her parents' place.
The company will move back into the downtown office once repairs are complete.
pastTenses: moved back into (past simple), moved back into (present perfect)
